targetText: It happened in those years when Russia still writhed in the clutches of darkest reaction, in the days of the Czar; the actors of this little drama were "emigrants,"
explanation: Setting the scene among exiled Russian Bolshevik revolutionaries living abroad under Tsarist repression.

targetText: The doctors had found that his wife was suffering from a serious heart disease and must have absolute rest and freedom from excitement.
explanation: Senya uses his wife's health condition as emotional justification to delay breaking off his marital ties, keeping Natasha in emotional limbo.
